reconcile_note: Reconciled inline by the opus driver from 3 independent prep passes (1 fast + 2 blind deep candidates) + a haiku grep backstop. Gate was BLOCKED on 4 material questions; Dalton answered all 4 in the Phase 2 interview (2026-07-20). Two answers (support holes, queue large files) expanded scope beyond the recommendation and are folded in below.
synthesis: Admins build Scout zones one polygon at a time in the ManageZones map editor; onboarding an org whose service areas already live in .kml (Google Earth / My Maps / GIS) is slow and error-prone. DEV-2201 adds an 'Import KML' action to the Zone Manager list (ZoneResource) that uploads a .kml file and auto-creates one Scout zone per polygon <Placemark> (INCLUDING interior-ring holes), org-scoped, default color/no-scan/no-driver, reusing the existing Zone geometry pipeline (definition JSONB -> rebuildGeometryFromDefinition() -> PostGIS geom). First bulk zone-creation flow AND first file-upload feature in the product. Per Dalton's grooming: .kml-only (no .kmz) for v1, allow duplicate names, SUPPORT polygon holes, and QUEUE large files (small files import synchronously with immediate feedback; large files run in a queued job with async Filament database-notification feedback).

scope.summary: New KML-parsing service (outer + inner rings -> GeoJSON Polygon-with-holes) + a shared import-executor unit (parse+create+tally, reused by both the sync path and the queued job so the loop is written ONCE) + a queued Job for large files + a static Filament Action wired into ZoneResource's toolbar. Small uploads (below a size/placemark threshold) import inline with an immediate summary Notification; large uploads persist the file to a disk, dispatch ImportZonesFromKml, and the job sends a Filament DATABASE notification (bell) to the acting user on completion. Each valid placemark becomes one Zone via the same definition-write + rebuildGeometryFromDefinition() path ManageZones::save() uses, each in its OWN platform-connection transaction so one bad shape can't fail the batch. One batched Analytics::track(ZoneImport) per import. Skip ZoneBroadcaster (no-op for driverless imports).

proposed_changes.change: Pure parsing service: parse(string $kml): list<{name, polygon: GeoJSON|null, skip_reason}>. registerXPathNamespace('kml','http://www.opengis.net/kml/2.2'), xpath('//kml:Placemark'); read <name> (fallback 'Imported Zone {n}'); read <Polygon><outerBoundaryIs><LinearRing><coordinates> as the outer ring AND each <innerBoundaryIs><LinearRing><coordinates> as an interior ring; STRIP altitude (3rd tuple element); force-close each ring; validate EACH ring (>=4 positions, closed) — invalid outer ring => skip placemark; invalid inner ring => drop that hole (keep the polygon). Emit GeoJSON Polygon coordinates=[outer, ...holes]. Non-<Polygon> placemarks skipped (counted). Never let a SimpleXML warning/exception escape.
proposed_changes.reason: Isolates XML parsing for unit-testability; AC3/AC4/AC5/AC7 + holes. app/Services/RDN.php:95-100 is the only namespace-aware SimpleXML precedent.

proposed_changes.change: run(string $kml, int $orgId, int $userId): {created:int, skipped:int, skip_reasons:[]}. Calls KmlZoneParser, loops results; per valid polygon wraps Zone::create([org_id,created_by_user_id,name,color=DEFAULT_COLOR,is_no_scan_zone=false,definition=['polygons'=>[polygon],'zip_codes'=>[]]]) + rebuildGeometryFromDefinition() in its OWN DB::connection('platform')->transaction()+try/catch; tallies counts; fires ONE Analytics::track(ZoneImport,[created,skipped]). Returns the tally. Written ONCE, invoked by BOTH the inline action path and the queued job.
proposed_changes.reason: Prevents duplicating the create-loop across the sync action and the async job (reuse/simplify). AC5/AC6/AC7.

proposed_changes.change: Constructor: stored file path/disk, orgId, userId. handle(): read the stored KML from disk, call ZoneKmlImporter::run(), then send a Filament DATABASE notification (Notification::make()->title(...)->body('N created / M skipped')->sendToDatabase($user)) so the bell shows the result; delete the stored file in finally. failed(): notify the user the import failed. plan_time_design_notes: SYNC-VS-QUEUE THRESHOLD (Dalton chose 'queue large files' — hybrid). Decide by a CHEAP pre-parse signal so we don't parse twice: recommend uploaded FILE SIZE (e.g. queue when > ~256KB; the 5-placemark sample is ~a few KB) OR a placemark count from a cheap count-only xpath. Recommend file-size threshold (config-driven constant) to avoid double-parsing. Plan to finalize the exact number; keep it a named constant.

FILE PERSISTENCE for the queued path: a queued job cannot read a request-scoped Livewire TemporaryUploadedFile. The queue path MUST persist the upload to a private Storage disk (store the path in the job) and delete it after handle()/failed(). The sync path can use storeFiles(false)+->get(). Plan to pick the disk (private/local) and cleanup strategy.

ASYNC FEEDBACK: queued job sends a Filament database Notification (bell) to the acting user on completion/failure. Sync path shows an immediate session Notification. Both report N created / M skipped.
REUSE: the parse+create+tally loop lives in ONE unit (ZoneKmlImporter) invoked by both paths — do NOT duplicate it in the action and the job.

geoJsonHasValidRing() is private static (Zone.php:303). Default: REPLICATE the >=4-position/closed-ring check inside the parser (keeps Zone blast radius zero); alternative is widening it public. Plan decides.
acceptedFileTypes MIME strategy needs EMPIRICAL verification during build (PHP finfo often sniffs .kml as text/xml). Combine broad MIME allowlist + explicit mimes:kml rule.
Local php.ini upload_max_filesize=2M/post_max_size=8M + Livewire 12MB ceiling cap ->maxSize() — fine at sample scale; note for QA.

HOLES: GeoJSON Polygon coordinates=[outerRing, ...innerRings]; ST_GeomFromGeoJSON in rebuildGeometryFromDefinition supports holes natively; ST_MakeValid repairs topology. Validate each ring; invalid hole => drop the hole, keep the polygon; invalid outer => skip placemark.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC1 — 'Import KML' action visible in the Zone Manager toolbar, gated identically to the resource (CLARITY_SCOUT + admin, OR admin_impersonator)
acceptance_criteria.reason: Reuse static::canCreate() (wraps ZonePolicy::create ADMIN-only) as ->visible; resource-level canAccess() already includes Scout flag OR admin_impersonator (ZoneResource.php:56-64). Defensive Gate::authorize once in the closure.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC2 — upload a .kml file; only .kml accepted; sane max file size
acceptance_criteria.reason: FileUpload real-MIME allowlist + explicit mimes:kml rule + maxSize. .kml-only (no .kmz) per Dalton.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC3 — one zone per polygon placemark (incl. holes), org-scoped, geometry visible/correct on map AND list
acceptance_criteria.reason: Zone::create + rebuildGeometryFromDefinition (identical to ManageZones::save); GeoJSON Polygon-with-holes flows through ST_GeomFromGeoJSON natively; list re-renders via existing forOrg() scope.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC4 — placemark <name> -> zone name, sensible fallback when absent; duplicates allowed
acceptance_criteria.reason: zones.name NOT NULL no default; fallback 'Imported Zone {n}'. Duplicates allowed per Dalton (no uniqueness constraint).

acceptance_criteria.item: AC5 — placemarks with no valid polygon geometry skipped, not saved empty
acceptance_criteria.reason: CRITICAL: rebuildGeometryFromDefinition only sets geom=null on an already-created row (Zone.php:281-288); never blocks Zone::create(). Importer MUST pre-validate the outer ring before create().

acceptance_criteria.item: AC6 — clear feedback (N created / M skipped); one bad shape must not fail the whole import
acceptance_criteria.reason: Per-placemark transaction+try/catch (NOT one wrapping transaction). SYNC path: immediate summary Notification. QUEUED path: Filament DATABASE notification from the job on completion. One batched Analytics::track either way.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC7 — imported geometry renders correctly; self-intersecting/non-closed rings repaired or skipped, never a 500
acceptance_criteria.reason: Parser force-closes rings + drops <4-position rings; ST_MakeValid repairs self-intersections; per-placemark try/catch guarantees no 500 even on the queued path.
One ScoutAnalyticsEvent::ZoneImport per import (counts in params), matching the single-event-per-bulk-action convention.

acceptance_criteria.item: Large files run in a queued job with deferred feedback (derived from Dalton's grooming)
acceptance_criteria.reason: Hybrid: below-threshold synchronous; above-threshold queued via ImportZonesFromKml with a persisted file + async DB notification.
